title: Best harness for Qwen 3.8 27b ?
body: I’ve tried Open Code , Codex and Qwen Code and so far Qwen Code seems to work the best for me , the only complaint I have about it is that the CLI interface is a bit rough / sloppy . submitted by /u/HelloWorld-Print [link] [comments]
